_doc: Where the store members the data cannot place by itself come from in the 3.4.3.54261 tables (read by dbcsources.py). source: a column ('12' or '12[3]'), 'id', 'parent' or 'zero'. why: the evidence (dbccompare.py output, AC's use of the member). fixup: a conversion DBCStores.cpp applies to the loaded value, named for the function that does it.

maxGroupSize.why: column 11 equals it on every shared row; column 9 (40 on Alterac Valley and Isle of Conquest) is the player cap

nameMale[0].why: columns 0 and 1 are identical in every enUS row; 3.3.5's order (male, then female) kept

nameFemale[0].why: columns 0 and 1 are identical in every enUS row; 3.3.5's order (male, then female) kept

flags.why: equal on every channel but 26 (0x40039 -> 0x40001: bits 0x38 dropped)

name[0].why: column 0 is the class name; 2 and 3 are its male and female forms (3 empty in enUS)

expansion.why: no 54261 column marks the Death Knight; a 3.4.3 account owns every expansion

Flags.why: the same flags plus a new 0x40000 on races 12 and 17

expansion.why: no 54261 column marks the Blood Elf and Draenei; a 3.4.3 account owns every expansion

Model.why: the camera model is a FileDataID now (column 3); M2Stores loads cameras by file name, and needs the D5 extractor to name them by FileDataID first

Flags.why: the same low bits, plus new 0x1000 and 0x2000 bits

CollisionWidth.why: the collision box was recomputed in 54261 (0.6944 -> 0.6111 on the same models); 13 is its width, 14 its height

CollisionHeight.why: the collision box was recomputed in 54261; 13 is its width, 14 its height

col1.why: referredAchievement: a criteria hangs under CriteriaTree nodes now (column 4 the criteria, 1 the parent node) and an achievement names its tree's root (Achievement column 13); the first node reaching an achievement gives 3.3.5's for 5661 of 6310, some node for 6146. 3.4.3 shares criteria between achievements, which AC's one-achievement criteria cannot hold (engine follow-up)

col4.why: the required count is the tree node's amount (CriteriaTree column 2): 6256 of 6310

col26.why: flags: the tree node's flags (CriteriaTree column 6), 6072 of 6310

BitIndex.why: no 54261 column; it fed 3.3.5's PLAYER_FIELD_KNOWN_CURRENCIES, which the 3.4.3 update fields replace

difficulty.why: column 3 is a Difficulty.db2 id; DifficultyIndex ranks its old enum value (Difficulty column 3) among its map's modes, as 3.3.5 numbered them per map (147 of 149 MapDifficulty rows). 3.4.3 uses 0 for every difficulty, which AC has no value for (engine follow-up)

multiplier: AC's 29 multipliers are 21 weapon subclasses then 8 armor subclasses; 54261 keeps them as a weapon array (column 0, 21) and an armor array (column 1, 8). Identical values across subclasses tie the matcher; the order within each array is the subclass order
the armor half: column 1, 8 armor subclasses

Flags.why: the same flags plus a new 0x20000

Date[16].why: 54261 keeps 16 dates; AC's 26 slots past them stay empty

TextureFilename.why: the textures are FileDataIDs now (column 12); the 3.3.5 calendar packet that sent the name is replaced by the 3.4.3 protocol

DisplayInfoID.why: Item no longer holds it: ItemModifiedAppearance (column 1 the item, 2 the appearance modifier, 3 the ItemAppearance, 4 the order) -> ItemAppearance column 1. 3.4.3 renumbered the displays: the chain gives 3.3.5's id for 14524 items and another for 12140 (item 17: 7016 -> 5661); 19432 3.3.5 items are not in the client tables

spells: the set bonuses moved to ItemSetSpell (parent the set, column 1 the spell, 2 the item count); it holds the same bonuses for 508 of 509 sets (760 gained a 4-piece) and its row order matches 3.3.5's for 505 [fixup: ItemSetSpells]
items_to_triggerspell: the bonus thresholds, from ItemSetSpell column 2 [fixup: ItemSetSpells]

reqhonorpoints.why: honor is currency 1901 now: columns 8 (ids) and 9 (counts); CurrencyCosts sums the counts of currency 1901. 3.4.3 halved the honor costs (6885 -> 3445)

reqarenapoints.why: arena points are currency 1900 now; CurrencyCosts sums the counts of currency 1900

MinLevel.why: Classic raised the dungeon levels (15 -> 17, 55 -> 57); 2 tracks it, 3 is the maximum

Difficulty.why: a Difficulty.db2 id; 23 and 24 are identical in every row of this build, so either loads the same values (which one the client reads is an exe check still owed)

TypeID.why: equal but for 3.3.5's heroic type 5, which 54261 folds into dungeon type 1 with the heroic difficulty in its DifficultyID

X.why: world coordinates now (3.3.5 stored (17066.67 - y) * 36); AC only tests for the all-zero default light, which holds in both

Y.why: world coordinates now; AC only tests for the all-zero default light

Z.why: world coordinates now; AC only tests for the all-zero default light

Flags.why: the flags were renumbered; the one AC reads, MAP_FLAG_DYNAMIC_DIFFICULTY 0x100, is bit 0x100 of word 0 (on 631, 724 and now 649)

entrance_x.why: 54261 Map holds no corpse position; the corpse query needs another source (engine follow-up: the instance's areatrigger_teleport)

Difficulty.why: a Difficulty.db2 id; DifficultyIndex turns it into AC's 0-3 index

areaTriggerText.why: the same message, now also the level requirements 3.3.5 left empty

resetTime.why: column 5 is the reset interval (0 none, 1 daily, 2 weekly); ResetIntervalSeconds turns it into the seconds AC keeps

Pattern.why: the same patterns, with the word boundaries written \b instead of \< \>; ObjectMgr strips both
the same patterns, with the word boundaries written \b instead of \< \>; ObjectMgr strips both

difficulty.why: PVPDifficulty keeps only the bracket, its levels and the map (parent); AC never reads PvPDifficultyEntry::difficulty

SupercededBySpell.why: 54261 records the other direction: column 6 of the next rank's row holds the spell it supersedes (5008 matches over 1059 3.3.5 pairs); InvertSupersedes turns it around

Targets.why: the only column that agrees (88%); the target flags changed on some spells

ProcFlags.why: the only column that agrees (86%): 3.4.3 changed the proc flags of some spells; the second word of the array is new

PowerType.why: SpellPower holds one row per cost (column 1 the order, 10 the power type, 2 the cost, 3 per level, 4 per second, 7 the percentage as a float): the first row that is not a rune or a runic power gain is AC's power, POWER_RUNE when there is none and runes are paid

ManaCost.why: SpellPower column 2 of the main cost row (98% of 6661)

ManaCostPerlevel.why: SpellPower column 3 of the main cost row

ManaPerSecond.why: SpellPower column 4 of the main cost row (6655 of 6661)

ManaPerSecondPerLevel.why: 0 on every 3.3.5 spell; SpellPower keeps no such column

ManaCostPercentage.why: SpellPower column 7 of the main cost row, a float now (8.0 for 8)

RuneCostID.why: rune costs are SpellPower rows (power types 20 blood, 22 unholy, 21 frost; 47-48 votes each against SpellRuneCost) and a runic power row with a negative amount is the gain (-100 -> 100); SpellPowerCosts builds a SpellRuneCost entry under the spell's own id

EquippedItemClass.why: column 1, -1 for a spell without a SpellEquippedItems row: agrees on 48633 of 48639

SpellVisual[1].why: a second visual, on 4 kinds of spells; SpellXSpellVisual keeps one row per spell and difficulty

SpellIconID.why: the icon is a FileDataID now (Fireball 135812), not a SpellIcon id; AC's 48 comparisons with 3.3.5 icon ids must be rewritten (engine follow-up)

ActiveIconID.why: the active icon's FileDataID; AC compares it once, in SpellInfoCorrections (engine follow-up)

SpellPriority.why: no 54261 column; AC sets it only in SpellInfoCorrections

SpellName[0].why: SpellName names 27272 spells; the 55% is the 3.3.5 spells it does not name (server-side ones), which load an empty name

Rank[0].why: 54261's Spell keeps the rank text (NameSubtext) first: 'Rank 1' on Fireball (85%)

AreaGroupId.why: an AreaGroupMember group now; 338 of 1003 keep their 3.3.5 group id

RadiusMin.why: AC's RadiusMin is the base radius: column 0; 54261 inserted a real minimum (2) before the maximum (3)

RadiusPerLevel.why: column 1, 0 on every shared row as in 3.3.5

RadiusMax.why: columns 0 and 3 agree everywhere; 3 is the maximum, after the inserted minimum

creatureType.why: column 1, equal wherever 3.3.5 has a type; its -1 is 0 now, and AC only tests for > 0

MissileModel.why: the missile moved to SpellVisualMissile; AC reads it only for a -4/-5 heuristic in SpellMgr (engine follow-up)
